summary: This PR fixes a long-standing issue with UserCreationForm and ManyToMany fields, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The duplicated `if commit:` condition is unnecessary and slightly unclear.
The added lines could be formatted to follow the existing code style more closely.
While the tests pass, it would be good to add additional tests to ensure this fix doesn't break other edge cases.
The fix is straightforward and doesn't introduce any new abstractions or complexity, but could be slightly more concise.
